correctness.rationale: Greedy subsequence matching in 0101... places last symbol exactly at F(v)=length+[first=1]+number of equal adjacent bits; absent from (01)^m iff F>2m. Deleting first/interior/final symbols drops F by 0,1 or 2; zero-drop witnesses are initial 01 and interior alternating triples 010/101, producing the exact minimality test, with final two equal required at F=2m+2. Unique run decomposition with internal runs length>=2 produces two rational weight series, parity extraction yields the stated rational GF and recurrence; shortest layer m+2 and pole asymptotics follow. Independently exhaustively enumerated and checked direct subsequence deletion minimality and the proposed structural criterion for every binary word up to length 2m+1, m=1..7, including 65534 candidates for m=7, and matched full degree counts. Infinite GF is symbolic, not finite extrapolation.
